name: 障害児入所施設に性暴力防止策を義務付け
summary: 条例第41条を改め、指定福祉型障害児入所施設の設置者に、児童対象性暴力等を防ぎ、発生した場合に障害児を適切に保護するための措置を義務付けます。措置には、障害児と接する業務のうち、支配性、継続性、閉鎖性のある環境で接する人の犯罪事実確認などが含まれます。令和8年12月25日に施行されます。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等の防止と、発生時に障害児を保護する措置を義務付ける
支配性、継続性、閉鎖性のある環境で障害児に接する業務の従事者について、犯罪事実確認などを求める
who: 指定福祉型障害児入所施設の設置者

why: 児童福祉法に基づく施設の人員、設備及び運営の基準が改正され、児童等を対象とした性暴力等を防ぐ規定を設ける必要があるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Requires facilities for children with disabilities to take measures against sexual violence
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Setagaya City Ordinance on Standards for Staffing, Facilities, and Operation, etc., of Designated Facilities for the Admission of Children with Disabilities
en.summary: The ordinance amends Article 41 and requires operators of designated welfare-type facilities for children with disabilities to take measures to prevent sexual violence, etc., against children and to appropriately protect children with disabilities if it occurs. These measures include criminal-record checks, etc., for people whose work involves contact with children with disabilities in settings characterized by control, continuity, and closedness. It takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Requires measures to prevent sexual violence, etc., against children and to protect children with disabilities if it occurs
Requires criminal-record checks, etc., for workers whose jobs involve contact with children with disabilities in settings characterized by control, continuity, and closedness
who: Operators of designated welfare-type facilities for children with disabilities
Children with disabilities who use designated welfare-type facilities for children with disabilities
en.why: The mayor says this is necessary because the standards for staffing, facilities, and operation of facilities under the Child Welfare Act have been revised, and provisions to prevent sexual violence, etc., targeting children and others need to be established.
